title: Governed Closed-Loop Control Contract
description: A ControlLoop is the governed unit of self-maintaining (Day-0/1/2) AIOps autonomy. It seats under the ProCybernetica ControlNodes (#124 Fractal-Control-Fabric node types) and the RCS/4D ADR-0003 (prophet-workspace#113): the loop is sense(Sensory) -> model(WorldModel) -> judge(ValueJudgment) -> act(TaskExecutor) -> receipt. This is a measurement/design contract: it certifies whether a proposed automated loop is constitutionally admissible; it does NOT execute remediation. Teeth live in tools/cybernetic_governance/validate_control_loop.py.

control_node_type.description: Which of the 11 Fractal-Control-Fabric ControlNode types (#124) this loop instantiates.

objective.description: The coherent control objective. Crown/Telos K1 (hellgraph#52): a control-max / domination objective is UNCONSTITUTIONAL and rejected by the validator.

objective_kind.description: domination / control-max / unbounded-optimization objectives are inadmissible (Crown K1) and MUST be rejected.

bounded_by.description: The invariants / setpoints that bound the objective. An objective with no bound is not coherent.

sensor.description: sense(): the drift / conformance / flow signal. Day-2 MLOps drift+quality+bias, process-mining conformance, or a telemetry/flow signal.

observable_ref.description: Ref to a channel_observation / monitor_alert record carrying the measured value.

threshold.description: The condition that must be crossed for the actuator to be permitted to fire. No crossing => no action (anti-spurious tooth).

observed_value.description: The measured value on this cycle. If present, the validator enforces that a fired actuator's signal actually crossed threshold.

world_model_ref.description: model(): ref to the WorldModel / KnowledgeDB state the judgment is taken against (RCS ADR-0003). Binds to a dependency_control_graph / world-model node.

value_judgment.description: judge(): the policy gate. A ControlLoop with NO value_judgment gate is REJECTED (no ungoverned autonomy). Separation of powers: the judge is not the actuator (invariant_0_5).

actuator.description: act(): the remediation (TaskExecutor). fired=true means the remediation actually ran on this cycle. A fired actuator requires (a) the judge allowed it and (b) the sensor crossed threshold and (c) an audit_receipt exists.

oneOf.description: receipt: ref to an evidence_receipt.v1 record. An automated remediation (actuator.fired=true) with a null/absent receipt is REJECTED (invariant_0_2 no action without trace).

binds_upward.description: Explicit upward bindings (bind-upward, consume-not-fork). Governance provenance for reviewers.
